hypothesis: The R159 code and frozen finance default configuration will complete the immutable 30-question cohort once with three live provider layers and simultaneously meet all three reader-visible product thresholds.

cohort.selection_rule: every frozen question exactly once on commit a487a75; no saved states, rerun, best-of, supersession, silent exclusion, or cross-run splicing

decision_rules.pass: The one merged exact-once artifact has 30/30 status=done, three-layer live fidelity, no saved states, evidence_reachable_rate >= 0.60, orphaned_sub_questions == 0, and false_premise_failed == 0.
decision_rules.first_candidate_passes: Publish this artifact as the product proof, run no second full cohort, and proceed directly to provider-free F15.
decision_rules.first_candidate_fails: Preserve the complete failed experiment, classify one defect class, change code under conditional F13, and treat any later full cohort as a new independent candidate; never splice cases or metrics.

power_and_noise.rationale: This is a census of the immutable acceptance cohort and a threshold decision, not an A/B capability-effect estimate; all 30 fixed cases are required.
power_and_noise.judge_samples_rationale: The three formal metrics are deterministic reader-delivery and behavioral measurements rather than LLM judge-score comparisons; one judge sample preserves the complete runner artifact without buying irrelevant repeated judge variance.
power_and_noise.historical_cost_reference: R149 cost CNY 13.70871656 for 28 successful cases and R158 cost CNY 4.61891248 for 8 canary cases.
power_and_noise.budget_coverage: Expected CNY 18; six CNY 8 shard fuses provide a CNY 48 round ceiling, which covers the census and remains inside the CNY 300 plan fuse.

stop_conditions: sum of the six shard ledgers reaches CNY 48
any shard reaches its CNY 8 fuse
credentials or third-party response bodies would leave ignored artifacts
a configuration error would violate exact-once, live-fidelity, or shard-ledger isolation before paid execution
rollback: Preserve every terminal and partial artifact, stop dependent paid work, and do not rerun, replace, or supersede a failed case on unchanged code.
